resources.string: Hello world, this is Supertonic TTS on Android. Select a voice and speed below!
Recommended: 3 for weak phones (sub-2 GHz CPU), 4-5 for mid-range, 6-7 for flagships. Higher = better prosody but longer first-word latency.
Would you like to continue reading from where you left off?
Would you like to start synthesis for this text immediately?
Audio is currently playing. Would you like to add this text to the queue or play it immediately?
TeraTTS speaks Russian and English and needs a one-time download (~390 MB). Download now?
This will remove the TeraTTS models and voices to free up space (~390 MB). You can download them again later.

Applies English-style rules for numbers, units, etc.
When on, the rules below rewrite text before the model sees it. Turn off to disable all custom rules at once without deleting them.
Block first synthesis until dictionary loads

Off: dictionary parses in the background after a cold start; the very first sentence may go without stress marks. On: the service waits ~5-10 s on first launch so every sentence is stressed from the start. Recommended only if the first sentence really matters (short automation TTS, single-word readouts).
Don\'t insert a space before ? and ! at the end of a chunk. Glues the mark to the preceding word so the model gets a stronger intonation hint.
Double ?/! at the end of a chunk (`Куда?` → `Куда??`). Some models react with a stronger prosodic contour; others ignore it.
Normalize `…` and `. . .` to `...` and strip whitespace before it. One expressive pause instead of three independent dots.
Skip the legacy `,/;` spacing stabilisation at end of chunk and the closing-quote+period split. Cleaner phrasing but slightly higher glitch risk on rare punctuation.

Correct stress needs a dictionary: 3.3 million word forms built by the silero-stress network (%1$d MB, once). Homographs (замок/замок) are resolved by context anyway. You can also do this later: Settings → menu (⋮) → Download dictionary.
Running — smooth reading with the screen off
Synthesis speed: screen on ×%1$s, off ×%2$s (over 1 = keeps up)
Open a book in the TeraTTS reader — its characters will appear here.
Characters of the text open in the reader. Changes apply the next time reading starts. If one character goes by two names, merge them.
Not from a book — shared settings
Own voices for the main characters: %1$d (others: shared male / female)
There is no direct speech in this phrase
Voices reset. The book is re-analysed next time reading starts; your corrections and merges are kept.
Synthesis on %1$d fast cores of %2$d instead of all. Faster on some phones, slower on others — compare the speed in the notification. Applies from the next phrase.
Fast cores could not be told apart on this device: the switch changes nothing.
The engine stays in memory with a “Running…” notification: instant start. Off: memory is freed 3 minutes after reading. Turn on only if there are pauses with the screen off.
Built-in reader: author text by the narrator, male and female lines in their own voices. Gender comes from the author words (said, he or she) and from names the book itself reveals.

Characters (Peter, Lena, the old man, the computer…) get different voices automatically and keep them in every chapter. Their pace follows the text: old people slower, «blurted out» faster, «whispered» quieter. Off: voices by gender only.
Pauses after . ! ? : ; — … and around (brackets). ×1 is the default; ×0 leaves only the voice model’s own pauses.
Silence after the last sentence of a paragraph, in seconds. Used when the reader sends whole paragraphs (FBReader does).

Insert a space between any word and a trailing `.,;:!?`. Belt-and-braces hint for the model\'s text tokenizer (`удивлён,` → `удивлён ,`). Leaves consecutive marks (`...`, `?!`) and numbers (`3,14`, `1.5`) alone. Off by default.

Small (120) — quick start for short messages. Default (300) — balanced, current behavior. Large (500) — smoother intonation, best for books. Huge (1000, experimental) — packs whole short paragraphs into one synthesis call.
Build up several sentences of synthesized audio in RAM (~1-3 MB) before playback starts. Smooths out pauses between sentences on weak devices. Costs a longer wait at the very beginning of playback.

Save my dictionary to a file

%,d entries are now active for synthesis.

Are you sure you want to delete all history items?
Downloading TeraTTS models (~390 MB, Russian and English). This happens only once.
Out of memory while parsing the dictionary. Either pick the binary variant of the same size (mmap, no heap) or switch to Standard (37 MB / ~150 MB heap) / Compact (22 MB / ~85 MB heap).
Network error. Check your connection and try again.
Downloaded file is larger than 250 MB cap and was discarded.
Couldn\'t read the dictionary. The file may be corrupt, truncated, or in an unsupported format.
I/O error while reading the source. Try again.
Another dictionary download or import is already in progress. Wait for it to finish and try again.
Assets not ready. Please download them on the main screen.
To the end of the chapter
Hello! This is how I will sound in this book.
Open a book from the library to search in it
All voices sound equally loud: as loud as the main voice, or louder if the main voice itself is quiet. Each voice is measured on its first lines

The old dictionary «%1$s» is no longer used: it has wrong stresses in places, and one stress for both meanings of words like замок. Download Silero (%2$d MB, once) — without it the engine places stresses itself and makes more mistakes.
Tap the stressed vowel; tap «е» again to make it «ё». Add a word next to it to set the stress for that phrase only
«%1$s» will be removed from the library together with its reading place. The book file in your phone\'s folders stays.

M4A file in the book\'s folder (Music/Supertonic Audio/<book>), named by chapter: 01 - Chapter title. The whole book: a file per chapter; on a phone it takes about as long as the book sounds. Chapters already saved are skipped, so a stopped saving can be continued.
To save audio files, allow the app access to storage
Last time the app or the voice engine (also when another reader used it) ended with an error. Send the report to the developer? It holds only the error, the phone model and the Android version.

In Russian text an English word is read the Russian way («Windows» → «Уиндоуз»), so the phrase does not switch language halfway. A sentence wholly in English is still read in English. Abbreviations (NASA, CDs) are spelled.
If reading crashes in another app (Moon+ Reader and others): reproduce the crash, then tap here and send the file. It holds only TeraTTS messages, the phone model and the Android version.

Your own timbre: a voice .json made for Supertonic (it fits as is) or the two TeraTTS files style_ttl.npy and style_dp.npy, chosen together. It appears in the voice list as my_<name> and can be given to a character.

Left: steadier, words are skipped or repeated less often, the intonation is a little flatter. Right: livelier, as the model was made, but it stumbles more. TeraTTS only: Supertonic 3 has its own settings (Voice model → Supertonic 3 quality).
Now: %1$s. Tap: the app tries all cores, fast cores only and the XNNPACK accelerator in turn (about a minute) and keeps the fastest.
Chosen: %1$s. ×2 means 2 seconds of speech per second of work; under ×1 reading will stall.
Continuing to save the book from the interrupted chapter
Saving stopped: the system closed the app. Tap to continue from the interrupted chapter.
Saving the book stopped and will not continue by itself. Open the book and tap Save again: finished chapters are skipped.
A voice noticeably slower than the main one (for example, one made from a recording) is sped up to it. Faster voices are left alone. Each voice is measured on its first lines
Remove the voice “%1$s” from the list? It will not be offered or given to characters. Your own (imported) voice is deleted; a bundled one can be brought back.
A quiet melody under the reading in the app\'s player: it plays while reading and stops with pause and stop. When saving to an audio file the app asks whether to mix it in
No bundled melodies — pick your own file
Mix the background music into the file?
Supertone\'s new multilingual model (31 languages, Russian among them). Downloaded when chosen, about 400 MB
Supertone\'s new multilingual model (31 languages, Russian among them). Downloaded
Download failed: %1$s. Check the connection and tap again — what is downloaded is kept
Download the sped-up Supertonic 3 (faster on phones)
Faster (8-bit) — for slow phones, downloads 66 MB
Normal (8 steps) — as Supertone has it
By itself; a hint only for words in your own dictionary and homographs
Marks + as it sounds on every word
Voice repair for TeraTTS (if it skips words)
A voice not made for TeraTTS (Supertonic 3, Superclonica) can take its speech rhythm from a native voice: the timbre stays, words stop being skipped. Supertonic 3 is not affected
A comma is read as a short pause without the comma intonation — sounds more natural (from TeraTTS-GUI by azimutspb). TeraTTS only
Cleaner sound in places, but about 3 times slower: reading may stall on a weak phone
Cleaner sound in places, but about 3 times slower. Switching on downloads 256 MB (once)
This voice was made for TeraTTS — in Supertonic 3 it sounds metallic. For Supertonic 3, make it again in the notebook with MODEL=\"st3\"
